column1: # dictyBase v2 — your own curation overlay
# Tab-separated, 10 columns. EASIEST: edit in Google Sheets / Excel and export
# as .tsv — the spreadsheet keeps the columns aligned for you. Empty cells are
# fine; just keep every tab. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Then run:  python3 scripts/merge_curation.py
# Columns:
#   ddb_id    DDB_G gene id (the stable key — never changes)
#   symbol    gene symbol (display only)
#   type      go | literature | summary
#   value     go -> GO id (GO:0006935) | literature -> PMID:38562996 | summary -> text
#   aspect    go only: P (process) | F (function) | C (component)
#   evidence  go only: IDA IMP IPI IGI IEP (experimental) / IC TAS (curator)
#   reference the paper you curated from, e.g. PMID:38562996
#   date      YYYY-MM-DD you made the annotation
#   curator   your name / initials
#   note      optional: GO term label, paper title, or a comment
# Add your rows BELOW the header line. To start from an example, copy one of
# the commented templates, remove the leading "# ", and fill it in.
ddb_id
